entries.headline: Six US transports and renewed Ukraine strikes reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States, a nuclear command-and-control aircraft spotted earlier, and Ukrainian reports of fresh missile strikes on major cities.

entries.headline: Six heavy transports and specialist aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft over the North Atlantic and continental United States, with a nuclear command aircraft and special reconnaissance aircraft spotted earlier. The visible post is truncated after that point.

entries.headline: Elevated Black Sea air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported military air activity over the Black Sea at nearly three times its stated normal level, alongside a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft and several transport aircraft airborne during the day.

entries.headline: Transport, command and coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport and command aircraft across the Atlantic and North Sea and 11 coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day.

entries.headline: Heavy US transport activity reported near North Sea and Baltic
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force heavy-lift cargo aircraft over the North Sea and Baltic and characterised the activity as unusually high amid tensions concerning Ukraine.

entries.headline: War Watch relays BBC Live casualty report
entries.summary: The account relayed a BBC Live-attributed report saying five people, including three children, were killed and 38 were wounded in one strike. The visible post did not identify the location.

entries.headline: US surveillance aircraft and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft over the Baltic, multiple transport aircraft across Europe and 11 coded radio broadcasts during the day. The visible post is truncated after referring to tensions concerning Ukraine.

entries.headline: Nuclear command aircraft reported over the North Sea
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft over the North Sea and separately cited missile attacks on Ukraine and Yemen and drone strikes inside Russia.

entries.headline: Missile attack and six US cargo aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a renewed missile attack on Ukraine involving hypersonic weapons and six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and surrounding region.

entries.headline: Elevated US military flights reported over eastern Mediterranean
entries.summary: War Watch reported overnight strikes exchanged by Ukraine and Russia and US military flight activity over the eastern Mediterranean at nearly four times its stated normal level, including multiple transport and command aircraft.

entries.headline: Six US heavy transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States, about twice the account’s stated typical number for that time of day.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report on Russia–Ukraine war
entries.summary: The account relayed a report attributed to @Robertchester-j5b saying Trump described the Russia–Ukraine war as nearing an end.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on L-39 Skyfox counter-drone upgrade
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that Aero Vodochody and Thales are equipping the L-39 Skyfox with a 70 mm laser-guided rocket pod for counter-drone use. The post does not state the test or deployment status.
